name: dsh-im-companion
description: dsh-im 伴生插件（IM Companion）：以 Agent 为单位，把飞书/微信/QQ 机器人收进 DSH 工作区，左栏绿灯、一键过滤、舰队总览、拖拽搬家，卸载即净。

scripts.build: npm run build:host && npm run build:client
scripts.verify: node tools/verify/render-client.ts && node --test tools/verify/features/first-view.ts && node --test tools/verify/features/left-badges.ts && node --test tools/verify/features/detail-drawer.ts && node --test tools/verify/features/left-filter.ts && node --test tools/verify/features/adopt.ts && node --test tools/verify/features/presence.ts && node --test tools/verify/features/welcome-banner.ts && node --test tools/verify/features/fleet-radar.ts && node --test tools/verify/features/session-header-model.ts && node tools/verify/features/session-header-render.ts && node --test tools/verify/features/connect-qr.ts
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run verify && npm run guard
